spans.s:
घट् (ङ) घटते 1.
a. To act, to strive.
(क) घाटयति 10.
a. To unite or put
together, to happen; to injure;
to shine; (इ, क) घण्टयति to shine.

घट्ट् (कि) घट्टति घट्टयति 1. 10.
a. To
move. With परि to diffuse; with
वि to rub or scratch.

घट (टः) 1.
m. A large earthen water-
jar;
Aquarius; elephant's frontal
sinus; suspending the breath.
f. टा A troop of elephants for
war; effort; assemblage. टी An
Indian clock; an ewer.

घट्ट (ट्टः) 1.
m. A ghāt, a landing-
place.
f. (ट्टी) Small one.

घाट (टः-टा) 1.
m. f. The nape or
back of the neck.

घटक (कः) 1.
m. A tree that produ-
ces fruit without apparent flow-
ers; a negociator of marriages,
a match-maker; a genealogist.

घट-ग्रह (हः) 1.
m. Water-pot bearer.

घट-दासी (सी) 3.
f. A procuress.

घटना (ना-नं) 1.
f. Effort; assem-
bling, joining, occurrence.

घट-योनि (निः) 2.
m. Agastya.

घट-राज (जः) 1.
m. A large water-
jar of baked clay.

घट-स्थापन (नं) 1.
n. Placing a wa-
ter-pot as a type of
Durgā.

घटा_टोप (पः) 1.
m. A covering.

घटिक (कं) 1.
n. The posteriors.
f. का
The ancle; a portion of time;
almost an hour.
m. A waterman.

घाटिका (का) 1.
f. Idem.

घटित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Made, devised,
happened, joined.

घटिन्ध-म (मः) 1.
m. A potter.

घटिन्ध-य (यः-या-यं)
a. Blowing in a
jar.
m. A potter.

घटी-कार (रः) 1.
m. A potter.

घटी-ग्रह (हः-हा-हं)
a. Taking a jar.

घटी-यन्त्र (न्त्रं) 1.
n. The rope and
bucket of a well.

घटो-त्कच (चः) 1.
m. Son of
Bhīma.

घटोत्कचा-न्तक (कः) 1.
m. Karna.

घटो_द्भव (वः) 1.
m. Agastya.

घट्ट-जीविन् (वी) 5.
m. Living at a ghāt,
holding the lathers clothes.
